spec.description:
FI24 Flexible Ductliner is a lightweight, flexible glasswool
internal liner specifically developed for air conditioning ductwork and
mechanical equipment. Possessing the high resiliency of a semi-rigid board while
retaining sufficient flexibility for roll form handling, it is designed for use
with automated sheet metal cutting and coil line duct-making machinery. It
provides thermal performance and acoustic attenuation to reduce fan roar and air
turbulence within HVAC systems.
features:
Nominal density of 24 kg/m³
offering optimal balance of flexibility and acoustic absorption

Suitable for
use with automated sheet metal cutting and coil-line duct-making machinery
Possesses high resiliency of a board while retaining flexibility in roll form

Provides thermal and acoustic dampening to control airflow noise and energy
loss

Available unfaced or faced with Sisalation Heavy Duty Perforated foil,
Vapastop 883, or Black Matt Facing

Non-combustible glasswool core complying
with AS 1530.1
Manufactured in Australia from up to 80% recycled glass

Low
VOC emissions and safe bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation

Complies with Australian
Standard AS 4254 for HVAC ductwork

technical.value: 1500 mm width x 12 m, 15 m, or 20 m length
Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0, Smoke Developed: 0-1
Up to 20 m/s (when faced with approved facing and pinned per AS 4254)

spec.fire:
Non-combustible core to
AS 1530.1; AS/NZS 1530.3: Ignitability: 0, Spread of Flame: 0, Heat Evolved: 0,
Smoke Developed: 0-1; Compliant with AS 4254 fire requirements
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4859.1, AS 4254.1 & AS 4254.2, NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability:
Contains up to 80% recycled glass content; bio-soluble FBS-1;
zero ODP; low VOC
install:
Feed FI24 Flexible Ductliner roll into
automatic duct-forming machinery or cut manually to duct dimensions

Apply 100% coverage of approved duct adhesive to interior sheet metal
surfaces

Press FI24 roll liner into place with facing oriented towards the
interior airstream

Secure liner with mechanical impact or resistance-welded
fasteners at centers specified by AS 4254

Coat exposed leading edges,
transverse cut joints, and perimeter seams with protective mastic sealant

Ensure all corners and turns are firmly seated to prevent airstream
delamination
selection_checklist:
Confirm ductwork sizing and automated
or manual lining method

Choose facing option (HDP perforated foil for general
HVAC; BMF for aesthetic return grilles; Vapastop 883 for sealed air hygiene)

Verify required R-value (e.g. R0.7 for 25mm, R1.5 for 50mm) to satisfy NCC
Section J energy efficiency

Confirm maximum air velocity within the duct
system (up to 20 m/s)
limitations:
Must not be installed in outdoor ductwork without external
weatherproofing
Maximum continuous operating temperature of facing is 120°C

Ensure air stream velocities do not exceed manufacturer tested maximums without
additional mechanical fastening

Backed by Fletcher Insulation
commercial product warranty

problem_keywords: thermal loss in sheet metal ducts
use_cases:
Internal thermal and acoustic lining of sheet metal ductwork fabricated using
automated coil lines

Lining HVAC plenum chambers and mixing boxes to suppress
fan turbulence noise

Acoustic dampening in low-to-medium velocity air
handling duct runs
not_for:
External duct wrap lagging (use FI22
Ductwrap or General Purpose Blanket)
retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher FI24 Flexible
Ductliner is a 24 kg/m³ flexible glasswool internal duct lining roll
specifically engineered for automated coil-line and sheet metal duct
manufacturing. Combining the compressive recovery of a board with the
flexibility of a blanket, it dampens airflow turbulence and equipment noise
while delivering thermal ratings from R0.7 to R2.0. Non-combustible (AS 1530.1)
and compliant with AS 4254, it is available unfaced or laminated with HDP
perforated foil, Black Matt Facing, or Vapastop 883.
